title: penguins
text:

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(
  penguins,
  aes(
    bill_length_mm,
    bill_depth_mm,
    colour = species
  )
) +
  geom_point()








Figure 1: Bill length vs. depth across penguin species





As shown in Figure 1, penguin species differ in bill morphology.
